name: Klan☆Gari
source:
Klan Klan (micronized) from Macross F is is captured by Vajuras and assaulted by tentacles. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047878.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
《超時空要塞F》中的克蘭．克蘭在微型化後被蟲族Vajra俘獲，遭到觸手襲擊。
